policy: PDP 1000×1100 occupancy. Size the glass, never the assembly — same rule as Boston Round hero locks. A capacity's mid-body width must be materially smaller than the next capacity in the same family. CAP OFF may shrink the whole composition to keep a 4% margin, but must never grow the bottle past the locked capacity scale. Paint-time scale is the temporary enforcement on published plates; republished plates bake these targets and then publishedPlateScale returns to 1.

Jordan 2026-09-20: enforce a Circle width/height standard like Boston so 15 ml reads smaller than 30 ml; re-export Cap plates with real margins; CAP OFF must not force the bottle oversized.
